assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia, reporting persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities.
A 48-hour Holter monitor has been ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording.
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of correlating symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
The claim is for CPT code 93226 representing a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the date of this notice.
